english.title: Opening a large store on Christmas Day
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the occupier of a large shop, opened the shop for the serving of retail customers on Christmas Day
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1 of the Christmas Day (Trading) Act 2004.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
occupier of large shop
opened shop for the serving of retail customers on Christmas Day

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 1(5) of the Christmas Day (Trading) Act 2004 and Schedule 1 to the Sunday Trading Act 1994 define a large shop as a shop which has a relevant floor area exceeding 280 square metres and the relevant floor area as the internal floor area of so much of the shop as consists of or is comprised in a building, but excluding any part of the shop which, throughout the period of seven days ending with the Christmas Day in question, is used neither for the serving of customers in connection with the sale of goods nor for the display of goods.
(ii) Section 1(5) of the Christmas Day (Trading) Act 2004 and Schedule 1 to the Sunday Trading Act 1994 define retail customer as a person who purchases goods retail and shop as any premises where there is carried on a trade or business consisting wholly or mainly of the sale of goods.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the occupier of a large shop, you opened the shop for the serving of retail customers on Christmas Day.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding £50,000

Time limit for prosecutions:
Six months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
